name: Discovery (STS 41-D)
about: Discovery (STS 41-D) (1984-093A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1984 Aug 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Sep  1), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW17); its coordinates are written from memory
